verdict.rationale: The Radeon RX 9070 XT is a graphics card. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in MCP servers and calls their tools is a category error for GPU hardware. The pack shows only ML framework and inference-library support (PyTorch, vLLM, llama.cpp) and a docs llms.txt file, and nothing showing the product itself consumes MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
